column1: # One row per Pill feature. Columns are separated by TABs. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# id | title | steps | wait | cleanup | iPhone key | expected state
#   steps, cleanup: pill.sh verbs separated by " ; ". "sleep N" waits. A leading "& " runs the verb in the background.
#   "@shot" takes an Android screenshot at that moment (several allowed, they are stacked); with none, one is taken after "wait".
#   $PX $PY in a step = centre of the idle pill. A failing step marks the row "android step failed" (cleanup still runs).
#   cleanup: "-" for none (an empty column is not allowed). wait: seconds between the last step and the screenshot.
#   Before every row Pill must be idle and nothing may be pending (the runner waits and resets); the end of the run restores the App menu.
#   iPhone key: alternatives separated by ","; each is a text searched (case-insensitive) in the Feature column of reference/ios/index.md.
#   Only simulator pictures (sim-*) match, except after "web:" (then only the other pictures). "=text" must equal the whole Feature text.
#   "#box label" picks one labelled crop box. "-" = no iPhone picture; "full" = no picture and the Android side shows the whole screen.
#   Simulator pictures are compared by whole-screen width; other pictures are compared by pill width.
#   expected state: type/kind/size of Pill's "shown" state at every shot ("*" matches anything). A mismatch marks the row "wrong state".
